decisions.reason: Removing the Hindi-only language requirement does not necessarily cancel or alter the independently specified keywords, source materials, and wording constraints.
The product-benefit sources, claims, and indication choices remain semantically independent of the removed script-language constraint.
The visual realism and native-looking UGC criteria do not depend on the script being exclusively in Hindi.
The already deferred landing-page and tracking audit is unrelated to the script-language requirement and remains unchanged.
